runtimeProtocol.inputParity: Original JPEG RGB and all 32 input tensors exactly match the native probe. Raw probability and half-threshold parity gates failed and remain failed; measure downstream behavior separately.

pipeline.selection: Keep every production crop. Only if none exists, accept an outline-supported neural proposal with observed rectified overlap >=99% and maximum axis-normalized extrapolation <=5%, always needs_review. Use analytic projective coverage; no mask score or template selects the crop.
pipeline.fits: Reuse the exact production fit if the crop is unchanged. Fit new neural proposals independently; retain all failures. Do not change masks, corners, model or thresholds per image.
pipeline.validation: Independent exported weave error <=3%, original feature checks, geometry/paper checks, production editable conversion and independent editable-paper audit. Visual review of all photos/crops and distinct outputs.
pipeline.missing: No manual rescue or result-dependent replacement. Record photo eligibility misclassifications and possible irregular weaving separately without removing them from primary denominators.

scope: Development follow-up on the previously inspected 32-photo cohort, source-separated from training. Actual browser WASM model fields with fresh current-main production controls and fresh 10-second fits; no historical fit reuse across engine changes. All numerical gate failures remain recorded. Not a new prospective evaluation.
